name: BisCustomAttributes
label: BIS Custom Attributes
description: Custom attributes to indicate BIS concepts.

SchemaLayer.description: Defines the layers in the BIS schema hierarchy.

enumerators.name: Core
enumerators.label: Core
enumerators.description: Layer for schemas that define the most fundamental concepts and key organizational strategies for all other BIS schemas.

enumerators.name: Common
enumerators.label: Common
enumerators.description: Layer for schemas that define abstract concepts and patterns used by multiple disciplines.

enumerators.name: DisciplinePhysical
enumerators.label: Discipline-Physical
enumerators.description: Layer for schemas that focus on physical/spatial and closely associated concepts, in light of a specific discipline.

enumerators.name: DisciplineOther
enumerators.label: Discipline-Other
enumerators.description: Layer for schemas that define concepts from modeling perspectives other than physical, in light of a specific discipline.

enumerators.name: Application
enumerators.label: Application
enumerators.description: Layer for schemas that define concepts that no other schema would need or want to reference.

SchemaLayerInfo.description: Declares the target layer in the BIS schema hierarchy for a schema.

properties.name: Value
properties.description: Layer in the BIS schema hierarchy that a schema targets.
